baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negative condition at word 4 is followed by an emphatic action at word 5 directed through the forelock at word 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: The actor is first left an internal route to cessation. If that voluntary brake fails, an outside force takes the body's forward control point and supplies restraint mechanically.

activation_trace.role: Restraint from an act supplies the voluntary brake whose failure triggers the condition.
Seizure by the forelock supplies the coercive grip that replaces failed self-restraint.
The forelock as a graspable front-of-head point supplies the bodily handle on which imposed control acts.

changed_reading.before: Continued misconduct is followed by an unspecified punishment.
changed_reading.after: The threat is an agency transfer: failure to stop oneself results in being stopped through forcible control of the body's leading point.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root at word 4 can name an endpoint, while the action at word 5 can carry pursuit and the noun at word 6 offers a point of capture.
baseline_models.mechanism: Failure to arrive at the proper limit does not leave the motion open-ended. Pursuit reaches the actor, catches the forelock, and physically delivers him to an imposed endpoint.

activation_trace.role: The endpoint reached by a thing turns cessation into arrival at a limit.
Pursuit supplies the motion by which an avoided limit catches up with the actor.
The seized forelock supplies the terminal capture point that ends the pursuit.

changed_reading.before: The condition asks only whether the actor quits.
changed_reading.after: The condition asks whether he reaches his limit willingly; otherwise pursuit makes his body encounter that limit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root at word 4 also carries reason named for restraining wrong, directly before the forelock-grip construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Reason is an internal inhibitor. When that inhibitor does not govern conduct, the promised seizure externalizes its missing function as bodily restraint.

activation_trace.role: Reason that restrains from wrong supplies the failed internal control system.
Forcible seizure supplies an external substitute for the reason that did not restrain.
The grasped front of the head localizes the replacement of cognitive control by physical control.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts obedience with punishment.
changed_reading.after: It also contrasts two control systems: restraining reason within and a grasp imposed on the head when reason fails.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The action at word 5 has color-darkening and scorching branches, and its object at word 6 is an exposed front-of-head locus.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside seizure, the action can leave a darkened or heat-altered sign on the visible forelock area. Continued conduct is thus threatened with involuntary visibility, not only displacement.

activation_trace.role: Reddish blackening supplies a visible alteration at the threatened bodily site.
Light scorching by fire or hot wind supplies a causal route for the color change.
The forelock supplies the conspicuous bodily surface on which the alteration becomes legible.

changed_reading.before: The future action moves or humiliates the offender.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting branch reading makes the action mark the offender at the forehead, converting concealed defiance into visible condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object at word 6 can branch from literal forelock to the selected or foremost part of a group.
baseline_models.mechanism: The body's foremost tuft and a group's foremost rank overlap as images of headship. Seizing the forelock can therefore carry a contained metonymic reading of capturing claimed preeminence.

activation_trace.role: The select or noble part of a group supplies a social-headship resonance within the focus noun.
Forelock seizure supplies the physical capture from which the headship metonymy extends.
Refusal to cease supplies the conduct that puts both bodily freedom and asserted standing under restraint.

changed_reading.before: Only an individual's hair is the object of seizure.
changed_reading.after: The literal grip remains primary, but it may simultaneously collapse the individual's claim to be the foremost or controlling social part.

context_deltas.mechanism: Naming as visible sign, knowledge as a distinguishing mark, writing by a pen, and the later attribution of falsehood to the forelock make the focus color/scorch branches behave like compulsory counter-inscription. A self-presentation that misstates its condition is overwritten at the body's most public front.

activation_trace.role: Dark coloration supplies the involuntary visible notation.
Scorching supplies the material process that writes the notation onto appearance.
The exposed forelock supplies the inscription surface.
The non-dominant visible-mark branch makes naming participate in public identification.
A distinguishing sign that guides recognition supplies the epistemic function of the mark.
The prepared writing instrument supplies the context's explicit inscription channel.
Falsehood predicated immediately of the forelock supplies what the counter-mark exposes.

structural_cues: Naming and teaching by pen occur early, knowledge and vision recur, and the next ayah morally qualifies the same forelock.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sign, mark, writing, darkening, scorching, and a false forelock; I infer a counter-writing relation among them, while literal seizure or scorching remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The color and scorch branches are isolated physical side effects of the threat.
changed_reading.after: The context turns them into a forensic mark: conduct that resists knowledge is made publicly legible on the forelock.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human begins as something attached, then imagines himself independent, yet is assigned a return. The focus seizure reverses that fantasy by reattaching the self-styled independent actor to an authority and trajectory he cannot evade.

activation_trace.role: The grasp supplies the enforced attachment that contradicts imagined independence.
The forelock supplies the bodily attachment point through which return is imposed.
Attachment and adherence supply the human's initial condition of dependence.
Self-sufficiency supplies the denial of attachment that the focus action reverses.
Return to a prior point supplies the larger trajectory completed by the bodily capture.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from created attachment at 96:2 through claimed self-sufficiency at 96:7 to return at 96:8 before the seizure warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attachment, self-sufficiency, return, and a forelock grip; I infer that the grip enforces dependence and return, while ordinary punitive capture remains equally available.

changed_reading.before: Forelock seizure is a discrete act of coercion.
changed_reading.after: It is also an enforced reattachment that exposes self-sufficiency as a temporary misreading of the human condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Transgression is imaged as water rising beyond its bound; the focus cessation root can image the terminal basin where floodwater settles, and return can image returning water. The seizure becomes the bodily arrest point of an overflow that would not settle itself.

activation_trace.role: A pool at a flood's endpoint supplies the receiving limit where uncontrolled flow finally settles.
Forelock seizure supplies the force that arrests and channels the human overflow.
The graspable front supplies a concrete capture point for the arrest.
Rising, sweeping water supplies the context's material model of transgressive excess.
Returning rain or water adds a counter-current to the earlier overflow.

structural_cues: Overflow at 96:6 is followed by return at 96:8 and later by the conditional demand to reach a stop.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overflow, returning water, a terminal pool, and bodily seizure; I infer a hydraulic analogy in which force settles excess, while the direct moral and physical senses remain primary.

changed_reading.before: The endpoint branch merely restates that the offender should stop.
changed_reading.after: The wider sequence makes stopping a hydraulic event: unchecked excess is caught and settled at a limit imposed through the forelock.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same restraint root first describes someone forbidding another, then becomes the condition that he himself must cease. Commands toward protection and the final refusal of obedience adjudicate the contest: the would-be controller loses jurisdiction and is placed under control.

activation_trace.role: Cessation in the focus reverses restraint back onto the person who had exercised it.
Seizure supplies the enforcement that follows refusal to relinquish unauthorized control.
The earlier act of forbidding identifies the offender as an attempted restrainer of another.
Binding command supplies the competing directive against which the offender's prohibition is judged.
Protection from harm supplies the proper end of the competing command.
The prohibition on yielding obedience finally cancels the offender's claim to command.

structural_cues: The restraint root repeats with reversed grammatical roles at 96:9 and 96:15, while command and obedience language surrounds the reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated restraint, binding command, protection, and non-obedience; I infer a jurisdictional reversal, while the narrower reading of one offender receiving a warning remains live.

changed_reading.before: The focus tells a wrongdoer to discontinue an act.
changed_reading.after: It reverses his own prohibition onto him: the attempted controller must release control or be forcibly deprived of it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The servant's chosen worship culminates in voluntarily lowering the head and thereby drawing near. The aggressor's head is instead controlled from the forelock. The focus threat becomes one half of a bodily polarity between willing abasement that produces nearness and coerced lowering that removes dominance.

activation_trace.role: The forcible forelock grip supplies involuntary control of the aggressor's head.
The front of the head supplies the bodily point contrasted with voluntary prostration.
Humble worship supplies the servant's freely chosen relation of submission.
The specified worship act supplies the action the aggressor had tried to obstruct.
Bowing the head supplies the voluntary downward posture that mirrors the threatened grip.
Drawing near supplies the opposite relational result of the servant's lowered posture.

structural_cues: Prayer at 96:10 is obstructed, the aggressor's forelock is threatened at 96:15, and prostration plus nearness close the sequence at 96:19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies worship, forelock seizure, head-bowing, and nearness; I infer a mirrored body geometry, while the actions can still be read as separate punishment and worship scenes.

changed_reading.before: The forelock is simply an efficient place from which to drag the offender.
changed_reading.after: It marks the coercive counterpart to prostration: one head is forced out of dominance, while another lowers willingly and approaches.

context_deltas.mechanism: Teaching and knowing establish possible understanding; self-regarding judgment then supports imagined sufficiency, while divine seeing closes the epistemic circuit immediately before the threat. When reason does not inhibit conduct despite knowledge and visibility, the focus grip externalizes the missing inhibition.

activation_trace.role: Reason named for restraining wrong supplies the internal faculty that should have stopped the action.
The physical grip supplies an external inhibitor after cognitive inhibition fails.
The front of the head localizes the displacement of mental government by bodily government.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the context's offered capacity for understanding.
Reflective opinion supplies the self-appraisal that wrongly concludes independence.
Knowing immediately before the threat makes the failure cognitive as well as behavioral.
Sight and insight supply the enclosing observation under which the conduct occurs.

structural_cues: Teaching opens the surah, self-seeing drives the claim of sufficiency, repeated questions demand reconsideration, and divine seeing stands directly before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies knowing, self-appraisal, encompassing sight, restraining reason, and physical seizure; I infer that external restraint replaces failed cognitive self-rule, while surveillance followed by punishment remains the simpler alternative.

changed_reading.before: The threat follows an offender who has merely failed to obey.
changed_reading.after: It follows a collapse of self-government: taught and seen, he still lets neither knowledge nor restraining reason govern, so government arrives as a grip on the head.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation repeats the forelock and grammatically loads it with falsehood and culpable error. That localization makes the focus grasp less arbitrary: the seized point is presented as the embodied front of deceptive, misdirected agency.

activation_trace.role: Seizure supplies apprehension of the bodily point to which agency is attributed.
The literal forelock supplies the metonymic site where the person's conduct is localized.
Immediate repetition keeps the same bodily site active while its moral description unfolds.
Opposition to truth supplies the first moral property assigned to the forelock.
Culpable fault supplies the second moral property and makes the grasp judicially targeted.

structural_cues: Ayah 96:16 is an immediate appositional continuation of the final noun in 96:15 and assigns it two active moral qualities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated forelock, falsehood, fault, and seizure; I infer embodied agency at the grasp point, while ordinary whole-person metonymy remains the grammatical alternative.

changed_reading.before: The forelock is an arbitrary handle chosen for humiliation.
changed_reading.after: The next ayah turns it into the bodily front of the offending agency, so the seizure reads as targeted apprehension of false and culpably misdirected control.

context_deltas.mechanism: A call to the offender's assembly is answered by a counter-call to agents of pushing and prevention. Against that social contest, the focus branch for the select or foremost group-member lets the singular forelock compress a collective hierarchy into its head, which the grip extracts from its protective gathering.

activation_trace.role: The select or leading part of a group supplies the social head represented by the focus noun.
Forelock seizure supplies the extraction and defeat of that social head.
The literal bodily forelock keeps the social-head reading anchored in a concrete grasp.
Calling by speech supplies the offender's attempt to mobilize support.
The non-dominant assembly branch supplies the collective body on which the offender relies.
The answering call supplies a symmetrical but superior mobilization.
Pushing, impact, and prevention supply the counter-assembly's operative force.

structural_cues: The singular forelock is followed by parallel calls, first to the offender's gathering and then to the opposing agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a select-part branch, literal forelock capture, rival calls, an assembly, and pushing agents; I infer that individual capture dismantles a social hierarchy, while a purely individual threat followed by group confrontation remains live.

changed_reading.before: The threat isolates one body before unrelated groups are summoned.
changed_reading.after: The grip targets the social head itself, exposing the assembly's inability to shield the person who claims its foremost position.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines peripheral clothing and grooming branches with a non-dominant sign mapping. It remains anchored in the focus action's garment and color branches and the focus forelock's grooming branch, sharpened by the context's deceptive garment and visible mark. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for deceptive presentation being overwritten, never as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus action at word 5 has both dyed-garment and dark-color branches, while the forelock at word 6 has a grooming branch.

activation_trace.role: Wearing dyed garments supplies the chosen layer of outward presentation.
Dark coloration supplies the involuntary replacement of that presentation.
Groomed or lengthened hair supplies self-fashioned appearance at the threatened site.
A garment that misstates its condition supplies the exact analogy of deceptive appearance.
A visible identifying mark supplies the public legibility of the overwritten appearance.

changed_reading.before: The threat acts on the offender without relation to cultivated appearance.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, it replaces a groomed, deceptive presentation with an involuntary mark that tells the body's condition more truthfully.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the tether comes from a non-dominant split mapping of the context's vision root. It remains anchored by the focus's literal forelock grip and bodily control point, and the sight statement directly precedes the threat. Downstream prose should label it a split-root resonance in which visibility behaves like prior binding, not a claim that seeing lexically means tying.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus takes a graspable front-of-head point immediately after the context closes with an act of seeing.

activation_trace.role: Forelock seizure supplies the overt physical binding that manifests the latent tether.
The graspable forelock supplies the tether's bodily attachment point.
The non-dominant binding-rope branch lets encompassing sight resonate as a tether already around the actor.
Known disclosure supplies the condition of inescapable legibility that makes the tether image functional.

changed_reading.before: Seeing supplies evidence for a later and separate seizure.
changed_reading.after: In the split-root resonance, being fully seen already functions like a tether; the future forelock grip makes that prior inescapability bodily explicit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a verbal summons is crossed with a non-dominant severe-push branch and then joined to pursuit and impact. It remains anchored in the focus action's pursuit and striking branches, with the two context calls and the pushing agents immediately following. Downstream prose should qualify it as a kinetic echo across split inventories, not redefine either call as assault.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus action at word 5 can branch to pursuit and striking before the context stages two opposed summons.

activation_trace.role: Pursuit supplies convergent motion toward the forelock.
Striking supplies the impact into which the rival summons materialize.
The forelock supplies the bodily convergence point of pursuit and impact.
The ordinary call supplies the first verbal mobilization.
The non-dominant severe-push branch gives the answering summons a contained kinetic echo.
Pushing, impact, and prevention stabilize the kinetic echo in the immediate context.

changed_reading.before: The forelock threat and the later calls belong to separate physical and verbal registers.
changed_reading.after: As a contained kinetic echo, the calls gather into pursuit and pushing until the verbal contest acquires a bodily point of impact at the forelock.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the neck image comes from a non-dominant split mapping of the obedience root. It remains anchored in the focus forelock grip and the final explicit head-bowing action, which together establish a real bodily axis. Downstream prose should describe only an exploratory vertical contrast between coerced head control and voluntary prostration, not make neck-extension part of the surface command.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus controls the front of the head, and the final context places obedience, head-bowing, and approach in one short sequence.

activation_trace.role: Forelock seizure supplies forced control at the top of the neck-head axis.
The front of the head supplies the axis's upper bodily point.
The non-dominant long-neck branch activates vertical extension as a contrastive posture.
Bowing the head supplies voluntary flexion of the same bodily axis.
Drawing near supplies the relational result of voluntary rather than coerced lowering.

changed_reading.before: The seized forelock and final prostration share no mechanism beyond involving a body.
changed_reading.after: The split-root neck image activates a vertical axis on which proud extension is capturable, while chosen head-bowing becomes the route to nearness.

strongest_changes: The threat became an agency transfer from failed self-restraint or reason to imposed bodily control.
Created attachment, imagined self-sufficiency, and return recast the forelock grip as enforced reattachment.
Repeated prohibition, command, and obedience reversed the attempted controller's jurisdiction back onto him.
Prayer and final prostration made the seized forelock the coerced counterpart of a voluntarily lowered head that draws near.
The immediate false-and-culpable description of the forelock made the grasp a targeted apprehension of embodied agency.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots support several mechanisms at once: brake and endpoint, grip and pursuit, visible scorching, bodily forelock and social head. Ordered context turned those into cognitive, hydraulic, forensic, postural, and social readings without forcing a single resolution; split mappings supplied additional tether, sign, push, and neck resonances that remain explicitly contained.
remaining_uncertainties: The degree to which darkening and scorching function as forensic inscription rather than physical side effects remains open.
The select-elite branch of the forelock root supports a social-head reading, but the bodily forelock remains the firmer anchor.
Hydraulic arrest is coherent across overflow, returning water, and the terminal pool, yet its causal direction is reader-supplied analogy.
The tether, materialized summons, deceptive garment, and neck-axis readings depend on non-dominant or peripheral branches and should remain exploratory.
